# theBOAT - Systems-First Automation & Web Studio

## About theBOAT
theBOAT is a systems-first automation and web studio based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, serving clients globally across Sri Lanka, UAE, USA, UK, and Australia. We build AI agents, workflow automation systems, custom web applications, Shopify commerce experiences, and premium brand identity.

Website: https://theboatgrp.com
Contact: hello@theboatgrp.com
Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka
Service Areas: Sri Lanka, UAE, United States, United Kingdom, Australia

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is self-hosted n8n secure?
Yes. Self-hosted n8n runs on your infrastructure (AWS, Azure, DigitalOcean). Data never leaves your environment. API credentials encrypted at rest. Audit logs track every execution. Meets SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR requirements when properly configured.

### What's the ROI timeline for AI automation?
Most clients see positive ROI in 2-3 months. A workflow saving 15 hours/week at $30/hour = $23,400/year saved. An $8,000 automation project pays for itself in ~5 months.

### Do we own the code after you build it?
Yes. All source code, workflows, documentation, and infrastructure configs are yours. GitHub/GitLab access provided on day one.

### Can you work with our existing systems?
Yes. We integrate with Shopify, Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce, QuickBooks, Xero, Google Workspace, custom APIs, and legacy systems. If it has an API, we can connect it.

### What if an AI agent makes a wrong decision?
All agents include confidence scoring and human-in-the-loop patterns. High-confidence decisions (>90%) execute autonomously. Low-confidence (<70%) escalate to humans. Critical actions always require approval.
